question:
**Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

A cage for small animals
solution:
The correct answer is '**Hutch**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Hutch**'.
 
• It means 'a wooden box with a front made of wire, that is used for keeping rabbits or other small animals'. [ख़रगोश आदि छोटे जानवरों को पालने का बक्‍सा (लकड़ी का बना हुआ और आगे तारों की जाली); दड़बा]
 
 
• *Example: I fed the rabbit a carrot through the wire netting of its **hutch**.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Hutch.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Cave**: a large hole in the side of a cliff or hill, or under the ground. (भूमि के भीतर अथवा पहाड़ी के पार्श्व में बड़ा छेद; गुफा, कंदरा, गुहा)
 
• **Shed**: a small building that is used for keeping things or animals in. [सायबान (कुछ चीज़ें या पशु रखने के लिए प्रयुक्त) छप्‍पर; शेड]
 
• **Hut**: a small building with one room, usually made of wood or metal. [झोपड़ी, कुटिया (प्रायः लकड़ी या धातु की बनी, एक कमरे वाली)]
